'''House Gilbearn''' is one of the known minor [[Nobility|noble]] [[House]]s of [[Andor]].

The only known member of the House is Lady [[Sergase Gilbearn]]. She lends her support to [[Elayne Trakand]] during the [[Succession Wars#Fourth Succession War|Fourth Succession War]].
